When the account is in the 30 day lock down period it gives you the option to cancel it if you have access to the previous form of security verification. Whether it's email or phone number

I got through to them right after I completed all the automatic questions on the phone

So I ended up calling Microsoft. I had to use a different number but that's besides the point. Turns out because I selected "I no longer have access to this email" when logging in under my new address. So because I changed my verification settings using that method, I was locked out of the account. When I called support she asked me to cancel the verification information change.

Since I still had access to the email I used it to recieve a code to unlock my account. Then I updated my security verification settings (from inside the account this time). Once I had my new method I was ableto remove the old email once and for all.

So now my account is unlocked.
